title: Old Fashioned Australian Vegetable Casserole
description: A nostalgic Australian dish featuring fermented flavors and a blend of vegetables, this casserole is a hearty and comforting meal option, it is also satvik-friendly as it does not contain any animal products except for parmigiano-reggiano cheese which can be substituted with a satvik alternative.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and sauté the onion until softened.
Add the mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced zucchini, grated carrots, grated cheese, salt, and baking powder.
Add the cooked mushroom and onion mixture to the bowl and stir to combine.
In a separate bowl, mix the tomato paste with the water to create a sauce.
Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with olive oil and add the vegetable mixture.
Pour the tomato paste sauce over the vegetable mixture and cover the dish with aluminum foil.
Bake the casserole for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
